runtime.execution: Node CLI with Ink/React UI and service container; separate editor GUI/core messaging path. Async provider loop launches approved tool promises in parallel.
runtime.service_boundary: Harness owns session files, globals and shell/background jobs; consumes configured providers, MCP/HTTP and editor host capabilities. No independent shared kernel fabric traced.

summary: Pinned final/read-only Continue includes CLI and editor agents with provider/tool loops, MCP, background shells, configurable policies and beta delegated subagents; traced child/global state and destructive CLI compaction limit isolation and original audit.

inspection.scope: Selected source excerpts trace exposed entry/loop/request/action/result/state boundaries and relevant capability mechanisms; listed tests are read as source only.
inspection.limits: No acquired code executed, dependencies installed or live providers invoked. Claims concern this pinned snapshot; untraced catalog tools and dependency internals are not inferred.

actions.name: Write / Edit / MultiEdit
actions.input: filepath/content or edit schema; model capability chooses editing tool
actions.lifecycle: preprocess preview then approved operation; Write traced, editing internals not traced

actions.name: Bash
actions.output: truncated stdout/stderr, error or background Job ID
actions.lifecycle: spawns owned shell; silence timeout resets on output; background signal transfers ownership
actions.authority: TUI ask/headless allow subject security evaluator

actions.name: CheckBackgroundJob
actions.lifecycle: polls existing job; not independently resumable execution
actions.authority: model; base registry and default allow

actions.name: Subagent
actions.lifecycle: awaits same loop with selected model; fresh child controller; restores globals finally
actions.authority: model when beta enabled; executor temporarily globally allows tools

actions.name: compactChatHistory / automatic compaction
actions.lifecycle: separate model request; successful auto path persists replacement
actions.authority: harness/operator; not native model original-restoration tool

actions.name: enqueueMessage / handleInterrupt / serve /message
actions.output: queued next turn or controller abort
actions.lifecycle: FIFO after response; serve owns response controller; does not prove child shell cancellation

actions.name: ConfigService.reload / updateConfigPath
actions.output: loaded config and dependent model/MCP reload
actions.lifecycle: no affected-workflow activation fence traced; active loop still uses passed model/API

actions.name: ReportFailure
actions.output: Failure reported acknowledgement or API/auth error
actions.lifecycle: posts FAILED and marks task complete
actions.authority: model, allow default; remote agent authorization required

actions.name: legacy slash command.run
actions.lifecycle: core generator invoked instead of normal model stream when legacy metadata present
actions.authority: configured command author/operator; not arbitrary model turn redefinition

actions.name: tools/call / callClientTool
actions.lifecycle: client/core dispatch; results recorded before streamResponseAfterToolCall
actions.authority: editor policies approve; host supplies IDE/file/process authority

filesystem.detail: CLI Read/Write actual filesystem operations, request-gated editing catalog, plus separate editor tool bridge. Output/read limits and security checks apply.

processes.detail: Bash owns child shells, has no-output timeout and foreground-to-background job transfer with status polling. Tool dispatcher passes no provider abort signal to Bash.

code_actions.detail: Native CLI file editing and Bash are code-action substrate; separate editor bridge supplies host tools. No language kernel or bounded structural-code oracle established by traced operations.

persistent_kernel.detail: No persistent interpreter/kernel established in inspected CLI loop, shell, child executor or editor bridge.

standing_database.detail: Inspected service container/history/job state is not an independently shared database execution/query contract.

workflow_programming.detail: Configured MCP functions and editor legacy slash async generators provide programmable composition. CLI beta child agents reuse its fixed streaming loop.

multi_model.detail: Child configuration selects its own model/API for Subagent and core editor selects role chat model. Distinguish from live peer collaboration.

live_collaboration.detail: Beta delegated child work streams results to one parent; no peer mailbox/IRC bus traced, and executor mutates global state instead of isolating each participant.

concurrent_work.detail: Approved CLI tool promises start during subsequent sequential permission checks, then join in original output order. Parallel Subagent calls can overlap global overrides; inspected unit tests mock executor and do not validate isolation.

steering_interrupt.detail: Operator queue runs after response and local/remote abort controls provider/compaction. Fresh child controller and Bash context have no parent signal propagation in inspected dispatch, so provider interruption does not establish quiescence.

turn_redefinition.detail: Loop recomputes tools/system per iteration; editor legacy command generator replaces normal stream. No model-owned custom settlement/request scheduler or arbitrary hot turn program traced.

compaction.detail: Automatic and explicit summary creation replaces history; continuation can add continue after compaction. This is one summary mechanism, not interchangeable managed projections.

context_repair.detail: Errors retain pre-compaction history in memory; successful replacement overwrites session JSON. No model tool for original fetch/append-only restore identified in these paths.

original_audit.detail: Session writes current history omitting system messages; compaction replaces history and shell outputs truncate. Tool timing and editor prompt devdata are partial records, not original event/transport/effect retention.

audit_query.detail: Session JSON/history and background status are inspectable records; no cross-event immutable audit query API established.

hot_change.detail: Config service reloads model/MCP and each loop step refreshes tools/system; active request loop retains its passed model/API. No deferred affected-workflow fence or atomic cross-service activation traced.

rebuild_continuity.detail: No outpost handoff, quiescent executable rebuild or preserved uncertain-action identity in inspected session/config lifecycle.

remote_services.detail: Consumes provider APIs and MCP; serve mode queues remote chat with per-response interruption. Server owns agent state and shell jobs, rather than an independent shared compute fabric.

self_improvement.detail: Model file/Bash tools can edit programs, but no model-governed trial/measurement/adoption loop or self-refit safety protocol established.

complaints.detail: ReportFailure is exposed only with agent --id and remote auth/API; it marks task FAILED/complete and sends error text. It is not a nonfatal agent-state grievance table.

authority.detail: Configurable ask/allow/exclude with headless wildcard allow; plan allows Bash. Beta subagent globally overwrites permissions to allow all; parallel tool launch makes that boundary materially weak for isolation.

evaluation.detail: Read tests assert mocked continuation/child formatting and simple real-shell outputs when executed; none establish child global isolation, compaction semantics or complete audit. Tests not run.

time_order.detail: Queue timestamps, per-dispatch Date.now duration, and original-index result ordering coexist with parallel completion and in-memory state; no durable global causal clock traced.

evidence.claim: Pinned README describes final 2.0 release and repository read-only maintenance status; CLI and editor hosts remain distinct source paths.
CLI loop refreshes history/system/tools per iteration, compacts around request/tool execution, observes provider abort and can insert continue after compaction.
Provider request uses passed model/API, assembled OpenAI history, tools, completion options and retry abort signal.
Assistant call IDs persist before preprocessing and execution; failed preprocessing and rejected headless work have explicit result/state handling.
Each permission check is sequential, but approved tools immediately launch into promises; Promise.all joins execution, so later permission checks can overlap running tools.
Final tool results are assembled in original call order, distinct from completion/event ordering.
Actual dynamic tool registry includes CheckBackgroundJob, model-capability editing choice, optional beta Subagent and MCP; several allBuiltIns catalog entries are not automatically request tools.
MCP tool schemas adapt to Continue tool.run; dispatcher passes tool IDs/count, records timing/telemetry and returns or propagates results/errors.
Read preprocess checks sensitive file concerns; actual UTF-8 read resolves path, divides output limits for parallel calls and marks read file.
Write validates path/content and previews existing-file diff.
Write creates parent directories and overwrites file, returning a diff for existing content.
Bash validates command/timeout, evaluates command-security policy and spawns platform shell with per-batch output limits.
Foreground shell can transfer the same child to background job ownership and return job ID; silence timer kills child after no-output timeout.
Output resets timeout and streams history; close/error clears timer, output is truncated, and nonzero exit rejects only when stderr exists.
CheckBackgroundJob returns JSON identity/status/output/timing/exit/error; missing ID reports available jobs.
Subagent native schema takes description, prompt and subagent_name; metadata placeholder is replaced by actual dynamic implementation.
Beta tool resolves configured agent/model, requires parent session, creates new AbortController, streams child output and returns completion metadata.
Child executor temporarily replaces global permission service with wildcard allow and global system/history methods, using a local initial prompt.
Escape can abort child; same streaming loop uses selected child model/API and finally restores global functions/permissions; parentSessionId is not used in this path.
Compaction makes a separate model summary request and returns a short replacement history rather than immutable context edits.
Successful automatic compaction calls updateSessionHistory with replacement history; failure retains current history.
Persisted snapshot omits system messages and normalizes user editor state.
History manager overwrites session JSON with current history and selected metadata; not an append-only original event store.
FIFO in-memory queue holds message/images/timestamp and emits changes.
Queued messages dispatch after response finally and a UI delay.
Interrupt sends empty remote /message request or aborts local compaction/provider controller; partial non-tool assistant can be removed from visible history.
Remote serve consumes queued messages one at a time, writes user history and creates per-response abort controller.
Config reload/switch updates dependent model and MCP services without an inspected active-workflow fence.
ReportFailure requires --id and API/auth, sets remote agent FAILED/error and marks metadata complete, unlike a nonfatal state-bearing complaint.
TUI defaults ask for writes/Bash/MCP; headless defaults wildcard allow; plan excludes file writes but allows Bash.
Editor compiles/prunes context before bridge stream, attaches provider prompt/completion devdata, and passes legacy slash metadata.
Editor tool calls preprocess and evaluate policies, including parallel approved readonly work while other calls await approval.
Editor routes client tools or core tools/call and stores context results/errors before continuation thunk.
Core selects chat role model; legacy slash command generators receive IDE/LLM/history/abort/fetch capabilities, otherwise normal streamChat executes.
Core supports HTTP and MCP tool routing with input coercion, timeout and returned error context.
Mocked compaction/provider test asserts inserted continue and repeated provider call, not semantic summary completeness or original retention.
Mocked child executor test checks inputs, streamed callback and completion formatting; does not exercise global state isolation.
Shell tests assert actual echo output and platform-shaped cwd when run; no background/cancel/concurrency oracle in this read portion.

tests.oracle: Asserts continue insertion and provider call count using fake provider and compaction; does not verify semantic summaries/original retention.

tests.focus: Child adapter schema and output plumbing
tests.oracle: Mocks executor/services; asserts prompt,parent ID, callback and task formatting, not executor concurrency/permission isolation.
When run would assert echo/cwd; inspected tests do not exercise cancellation/background ownership. Not executed.

strengths: Actual CheckBackgroundJob handle and transfer of existing shell process avoid launching a replacement job.
Request-boundary system/tools refresh and programmable editor legacy async commands are concrete extension mechanisms.
Structured tool result IDs and stable final ordering preserve provider-call pairing under concurrent completion.
limits: Pinned README states final 2.0 release and read-only repository; conclusions describe this snapshot.
Beta child executor temporarily overwrites global permission/system/history behavior while generic dispatcher permits concurrent tool execution; isolation is unproven and structurally fragile.
Successful CLI compaction saves replacement history; system messages and untruncated shell/provider originals are not durably retained by these paths.
Provider abort is not evidence of Bash/child quiescence; global services can reload while active loop holds older model/API.
ReportFailure closes task status and is remote-auth dependent, unlike nonfatal state-bearing rageshake.
arconaut_questions: Make each arconaut participant a scoped consumer of provider/context/authority services; which exact state must never be a mutable process-global override?
Use immutable originals plus separately versioned projections so models can repair compaction through an ordinary authorized API.
What ownership handles and acknowledgements prove every harness-owned active shell/provider is quiescent before arcorefit?
Separate nonfatal LLMmmshake filing from task failure/completion and record complaint state in an external database.
